big_idea: Your counter, assembled: screen 1 is a quote composer (restaurant, shop or office; tills; Wi-Fi, backup, managed IT) that builds the kit in studio-lit 3D beside a plain-words list, then emails the list to sales@.
notes: Built from approved job spec 2026-11-22 by an unattended worker; design.md in the source folder. No new research.
3D is procedural (Kit3D.tsx, drei RoundedBox, studio Lightformers, ContactShadows); poster kit-poster.jpg rendered at build time with swiftshader.
Kit list counts (one access point per four tills, one kitchen printer, cable runs) are starting estimates, listed as assumptions in the concept notes.
Critic non-blocking follow-ups: two rows of terminals on phone above 3 tills; check contact shadow strength on a real phone GPU.
Section 2 and 4 photographs remain illustrative (Lovable asset project), labelled.
